about_item: 1. BE PREPARED FOR ANY PET EMERGENCY – Vet-approved dog & cat first aid kit with pet-safe medical supplies, perfect for home, car, and outdoor adventures. Designed for fast, effective emergency care.
2. MORE THAN JUST BANDAGES – Includes vet-wrap, tick remover, first aid pads, saline wash, styptic pencil, slip leash & thermal blanket—real pet essentials, not just human first aid items.
3. BUILT FOR TRAVEL & ADVENTURE – Water resistant, hard-sided case protects supplies in your car, backpack, or RV. Ideal for hiking, road trips, camping, and disaster preparedness.
4. STEP-BY-STEP PET FIRST AID GUIDE – Easy-to-follow vet-reviewed manual for treating wounds, bites, bleeding, and emergencies—so you’ll always know what to do.

5. PET-SAFE & NON-TOXIC MATERIALS – Every item is vet-reviewed and made with pet-safe, non-toxic materials. Trusted by pet sitters, trainers, groomers, and adventurers—your pet deserves the best care!
6. COMPACT, DURABLE & ORGANIZED CASE: Our hard-sided waterproof case features a strong zipper, mesh pockets, and reflective printing. Compact and customizable, with space for additional items.

7. THE RUBYLOO PROMISE: We're a woman-owned US small business and quality and customer service are our top priorities; we're here for you and we want you and your pup to be completely satisfied with your purchase.

authors_reviews.title: Essential Kit for Pet Emergencies
authors_reviews.text: I recently used the Dog First Aid Kit and found it indispensable for pet emergencies. It's packed with a variety of medical essentials that helped me feel prepared for any situation. The kit includes a pet first aid book, which is a fantastic resource for quick guidance in emergencies.The tick remover and slip leash were particularly handy during a camping trip. I appreciated the quality and durability of these tools. They made dealing with ticks straightforward, and the slip leash was sturdy and reliable. The comprehensive range of supplies, from bandages to antiseptic wipes, ensured that I had everything I needed to treat minor injuries and issues on the spot.I did notice that the kit is quite compact, which is great for portability, but it can be a bit challenging to repack everything neatly after use. Despite that, the compact size made it easy to store in the car or pack for trips.This first aid kit is a must-have for any pet owner. It provides peace of mind knowing that you are equipped to handle emergencies, whether at home or on the go. The thoughtful selection of items shows that it’s designed with pet safety in mind.
